change: MCP servers work on both transports; chat discovers their tools through a compact sorted index instead of hundreds of tool definitions (mcp_tools_info / mcp_call), published prompts stay usable, local servers spawn with a minimal environment instead of Omi's full process env, and dropped SSE servers reconnect before giving up. Installing a skill brings its scripts and references instead of just the instructions, skills load a section at a time with parts returned by default, and the disable toggle now fully hides a skill from the assistant
